items.q: What did Boseman hide between Marvel shoot days?
items.a: **Stage 3 colon cancer** from 2016. Chemo and surgery in the gaps. Almost nobody knew. Died 2020 at **43**. Same pattern: Rickman shot *Order of the Phoenix* after a prostate diagnosis; O'Hara kept working with private rectal cancer until a PE killed her.

items.q: How did Ledger's meds kill him if the doses were not huge?
items.a: **Polypharmacy respiratory depression.** Oxycodone + hydrocodone + diazepam + temazepam + alprazolam + doxylamine. He fell asleep, breathing slowed, he did not wake. Video said 26; **he was 28.** Same family: Garland barbiturates, Hoffman mixed bag, Fisher tox + sleep apnea, Phoenix cocaine/morphine at 23.

items.q: What did Robin Williams have that was labeled Parkinson's?
items.a: **Lewy body dementia.** Autopsy, not the living diagnosis. 39 of 40 common LBD signs; wife thinks he hid the hallucinations. Anti-anxiety meds can worsen the paranoia. Died at 63.

items.q: How did the youngest person on the list die?
items.a: Cameron Boyce, 20. **SUDEP** — sudden unexpected death in epilepsy — in his sleep after a seizure.
